title: What If All the Oil on Earth Vanished Overnight?

scenes.text: What if every drop of oil vanished overnight? Empty gas stations would be the smallest problem.
The world uses about 100 million barrels of oil every single day. In the US, two thirds of it moves vehicles.
Gasoline alone is about 43 percent of US oil use. Diesel and heating oil add another 20 percent.
Jet fuel goes too, about 1.5 million barrels a day in the US. Planes would be grounded.
Refineries also feed the petrochemical industry, which makes plastics, polyurethane and solvents. Those supply lines stall too.
Trucks, ships, tractors and planes all run on oil products. Take it away and the whole supply chain stops with it.

description:
What if all the oil on Earth vanished overnight? The world burns about 100 million barrels a day, and two thirds of US oil goes to transportation.
Fuel, jet fuel, plastics and farm diesel would all vanish with it.
What should we run through next?
